instructions:
LRD-preconditioned mclmc on ill_cond_50 (kappa=1000 rotated Gaussian).
Pipeline: (1) 1000-step diagonal NUTS pilot; (2) rank-40 SVD extraction via
`extract_lrd_from_samples`; (3) `mclmc_find_L_and_step_size` with `make_lrd_kernel`
binding the LowRankInverseMassMatrix.
See `tuningfork/catalog/mclmc-routing-taxonomy.md` for routing context.
Expected ESS/grad: ~0.249 (426x over diagonal baseline at 0.0006).
notes: LRD preconditioning (k=40, pilot NUTS extraction) is required — diagonal mclmc_tuning fails (see failed__mclmc__mclmc_tuning.json). This recipe documents the certified LRD outcome; the inverse_mass_matrix is extracted adaptively at runtime via a NUTS pilot run. Multi-seed hardening: seeds 11111/22222/33333 all PASS at ESS 1944-2030 (@statistician, 2026-06-09).

override.reason: Independent reproduction confirmed. LRD k=40 (NUTS-pilot extracted) achieves R-hat=1.0039, ESS=1993.3, ESS/grad=0.2492 vs diagonal ESS/grad=0.0006 (426x improvement). Multi-seed hardening (seeds 11111/22222/33333) all PASS at ESS 1944-2030. diagonal mclmc_tuning is an honest FAIL on kappa=1000 at any practical warmup budget (see failed__mclmc__mclmc_tuning.json). LRD is the only viable mclmc path for this geometry.
